newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Procom begun with buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Procom begun with buy.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth Inc said Monday it began coverage of Procom Technology Inc with a buy rating.

-- Company highlights include the CD-ROM server company's position in that market, a proven management team, new technologies in development that will spur demand for optical storage, and an excellent distribution network, analyst Reid Dabney wrote in a research report.
-- Price target is $19 a share. Shares were up 2-1/4 at 15-1/8 Monday.
